final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT tr.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON a.translink = tx.transreg JOIN trader AS tr ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY tr.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT trader_type, analysis_count, analysis_count * 1.0 / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), compared AS (SELECT trader_type, analysis_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT trader_type, analysis_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM compared WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL AND share > average_share
